title: this is your sign to go see @Beaches the Musical with your best frien...
transcript: What if the most important love story of your life wasn't romantic? That is what beaches the musical is all about. And honestly, this musical hit me so hard because I went with one of my best friends, Nicole, and we love getting to watch a friendship just like ours come to life on stage, although theirs is a little more dramatic. The show is about Cece and birdie, two girls with totally different lives who meet on the beach one summer. And that chance meeting on the beach leads to a lifelong friendship. Decades of laughter and chaos, of career choices and distance and love. But it doesn't pretend that intense friendships like these are always easy. It's messy and sometimes painful. But ultimately, it is their friendship that holds everything else in their lives together. I knew beaches would make me emotional, but it also made me laugh a lot. Especially young Cece and birdie, truly the funniest and most talented kids I've ever seen on stage. And, of course, Jessica Vasquez and Kelly Barrett, who carry the show with their in incredible chemistry and unreal talent and charm. The music is just big, classic Broadway in all of the best ways. And of course, you get Wind Beneath My Wings, which will undoubtedly make you tear. This is one of those shows that will remind you to hug your people a little bit tighter and make you so thankful for all the friends who've made your life Better. So grab your best friend and go see beaches, a new musical on Broadway right now. I promise you're gonna Wanna be there with them. Wish I could be like you.
reasoning: Ash shows strong enthusiasm throughout, explicitly recommends seeing the show ('grab your best friend and go see beaches'), and highlights multiple positive elements including performances, music, and emotional impact. The personal connection and clear advocacy signal a rave review.
